articles.title: #Exclusive | ‘Real-Life Hero’: Fauda Actor Yaakov Zada Honours Captain Smit Machchhar | News18
articles.description: Fauda actor Yaakov Zada pays tribute to Indian Captain Smit Machchhar, the Flydubai pilot who was seriously injured during an alleged cockpit attack on Flight FZ1073.In an exclusive conversation with CNN-News18, Zada honours Machchhar and describes him as a “real-life hero” after his actions during the crisis helped passengers and crew regain control of the aircraft.Machchhar was attacked by his co-pilot during the Dubai-to-Tel Aviv flight. Despite suffering serious injuries, he managed to open the cockpit door, allowing passengers to enter and restrain the attacker. The aircraft was subsequently diverted and landed safely in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia.Captain Machchhar has since received widespread praise for his courage and quick thinking.
